Taught: the judiciary protects Fundamental Rights — Article 32 gives direct access to the Supreme Court and Article 226 to the High Courts.
Taught: the National Human Rights Commission was established by law in 1993 (NCERT Ch. 2); the Act is the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993.
